title: Corbell first meets Bob Lazar at John Lear's house
place_text: John Lear's house, Las Vegas, Nevada

tellings.quote: Oh, and he goes, "Lazar's coming over." It's first thing he says to me.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who makes documentaries about UFOs, says he first met Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, at the Las Vegas house of John Lear, a pilot known for his UFO claims, some time in the 2010s. Corbell says that the first thing Lear told him was, "Lazar's coming over." He tells it as his own memory of how he came to know Lazar.
